stories.title: Connah’s Quay Motor World shop to become café after plans approved
stories.summary: The Motor World shop on Connah’s Quay High Street can become a café with outdoor seating, after Flintshire County Council approved the plans despite neighbours’ objections. stories.title: Safety first as councillor tells Flintshire residents with on-street parking not to buy electric cars
stories.summary: Flintshire’s Cabinet Member for the Environment has advised residents not to purchase electric cars if they can’t charge them. stories.title: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board sees increase in “never events”
stories.summary: The number of “never events” has increased within Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board over the past 12 months.
